name: tests-75pct-cyclopts-validator-aware-shell-completion
instr:
Add validator-aware completion analysis and generation. Preserve existing behavior.

These are required in what you deliver:

- `cyclopts.Group(..., validator=..., completion=...)`; `CompletionGroupPolicy.AUTO` and `DISABLED`. Accept `'auto'`; invalid policies raise ValueError at construction.
- From `cyclopts.completion`: `CompletionConstraint` (command_path, group_name, member_names, minimum, maximum, allow_none), `CompletionState` (command_path, selected_members, after_delimiter), `CompletionDecision` (names, allowed, constraint, reason), `CompletionAnalysis` (constraints, state, decisions, diagnostics), `CompletionConstraintError`, `CompletionConstraintMode.IGNORE/WARN/ERROR`, and `CompletionAnalyzer(app)` with `analyze(words)`.
- App methods `analyze_completion(words)`, `generate_completion(*, prog_name=..., shell=..., constraint_mode=...)`, and `install_completion(*, shell=..., output=..., add_to_startup=..., constraint_mode=...)`.

AUTO exposes MutuallyExclusive maximum 1 and LimitedChoice bounds, including optional all-or-none bounds equal to member count. DISABLED yields no constraints. Constraints, state, and decisions reject mutation. Repeated analysis is equal; constraints follow command-path/declaration order, and decisions/diagnostics are deterministic.

Aliases and positive/negative Boolean spellings share member identity. Resolve lazy commands and nested command scope. Equals assignments select the option, not its value; double dash records delimiter state and
